## Manager's note — FP-1188 loading result: NOT completed / plate NOT released

I was unable to finish loading plate FP-1188, so I did **not** run `station release`; the plate is still out of the CMM queue.

**What went right**
- Five of six bushings are placed and appear well centred on their markers:
  - K1 → M1: placed (307.80, 294.24) vs M1 (307.87, 294.18)
  - K2 → M2: placed (417.87, 292.73) vs M2 (417.90, 292.82)
  - K3 → M3: placed (527.95, 291.50) vs M3 (527.95, 291.44)
  - K4 → M4: placed (306.55, 184.25) vs M4 (306.57, 184.19)
  - K6 → M6: placed (526.47, 181.42) vs M6 (526.51, 181.43)

**What blocked completion**
- **K5 cannot be seated on M5 because of hold-down clamp C2.** C2 sits on the front edge next to M5, and its lip obstructs the marker. Every attempt — straight `place` at M5, approaching from the back/side, or placing clear of the clamp and then `nudge`-ing — stopped the bushing about **1.2–1.3 mm short** in Y (consistently at y ≈ 184.1 mm vs M5 at y = 182.85 mm). The clamp returns the message *"against the lip of clamp C2"*. C2 is bolted (M6 socket-head screws) and cannot be moved, picked, or nudged by the robot, and there is no clamp-release tool available on the workstation. The reported lip clearance (8.7 mm from M5 centre) is less than the 10 mm bushing radius, so the bushing physically cannot centre on M5 with C2 in its current position.

**Conclusion**
This is a fixture/setup problem, not a placement-sequence problem: C2 needs to be repositioned or its lip relieved before M5 can be loaded. Recommend the plate be re-fixtured (C2 moved or the M5 marker/bushing position adjusted) and re-checked. K5 is currently sitting on the plate at approximately (416.60, 184.13), not on its marker, so the plate must not go to the CMM as-is.

No vision check PASS was obtained; nothing was released.
